title: Música, maestro
theme: Light theme: the two long acrosses (ACOMPAÑAS, CANCIONES) and TRIOS are musical.

clues.10A: Lo provoca una película de terror
clues.11A: Tocas la guitarra mientras otro canta
clues.14A: Nombre de mujer que es palíndromo
clues.17A: Por ahí se agarra la taza
clues.29A: Llamada de auxilio en el mar
clues.1D: Entradas del mar típicas de Galicia
clues.6D: Monte de piedra, o club de aficionados
clues.16D: Donde entra el balón en básquet

unsure.SARI: The Indian garment; in the RAE dictionary, but not an everyday word.
unsure.MIEDO: Checked against the content rule (nothing sad): a common neutral word, clued through horror films. Swap if the reviewer finds it off-tone.
unsure.ADAN / ANA: Two proper names in one small grid.
unsure.PEÑA: Two senses in one clue (a crag; a fan club, mostly Spain and the Río de la Plata).
unsure.ARO: Clued as the basketball hoop ('básquet' is the Latin American form; Spain says 'baloncesto').
unsure.COL: 'Repollo' is the usual word in much of Latin America, 'col' in Spain and Mexico. The clue relies on both being understood.
unsure.RIAS: Clued as the Galician inlets (rías), a Spain-specific geography word; the alternative is the verb form 'rías' (subjunctive of reír).
unsure.IRE: Future of ir (iré); common, but a conjugation.

build: Hand pattern, 12 blocks, rotational, every run 3+: .../.../ full row / .....#... / ###...### and its mirror.

CANCIONES locked in row 7 (locked letters must be ASCII, so a word with Ñ cannot be locked). At floor 52, 120 tries gave 56 distinct fills; several put ACOMPAÑAS in row 3 by themselves, crossing PEÑA at the Ñ.
Second pass: top half kept, lower-left corner refilled (floor 50, 300 tries, 14 distinct) to drop VIUDA, ENANO, ACNE and CAIN. This fill has TRIOS and two more Ñ crossings (AÑO/CEÑO).
Did not work: two locked music nines (CANCIONES with GUITARRAS, TROMPETAS, ORQUESTAS or CANTANTES) were unfillable at floor 50; TROMPETAS and ORQUESTAS alone only fit row 7.
Approving a word for a slot through the engine's `approved` rule returned unfillable where locking the same letters filled. Not investigated.

Third pass: the upper-left corner was swapped from ORO/VOS/LASER (downs OVAL, ROCA, OSOS, MES) to ROL/IRE/SANAR, another of the engine's fills for the same pattern, because every floor-50 fill of the 15×15 needs OVAL or ORAL and the same-day rule forbids sharing a 4+ entry.
